_note: Authoritative author-date reference list for Paper A, in IP&M's printed style (APA-like: author surnames + initials, year, title, venue, volume(issue), pages, DOI). Built from results/reference_metadata.json (full author lists resolved through the literature index) and cross-checked against the manuscript's existing entries.
